episodes.notes: Atomic-scale journey into the luminal beta-tubulin taxane pocket (PDB 1JFF): distinguishing Cremophor EL complement-mediated infusion anaphylaxis from delayed neutropenia, M-loop lateral protofilament stabilization, and multipolar mitotic spindle catastrophe in human tumors.

episodes.label: The Protein the Stain Could Not Name — Cardiac Lambda AL Amyloidosis With Positive Bone Scintigraphy (H029), Gillmore Nonbiopsy Specificity & Laser-Microdissection LC-MS/MS Typing
episodes.notes: Diagnostic decision rules and proteomic tissue typing in cardiac amyloidosis (H029): Nguyen et al.'s (2021) lambda light-chain AL cardiac amyloidosis case with strongly positive technetium pyrophosphate uptake, Gillmore et al.'s (2016) dual requirement of Grade 2/3 bone scintigraphy AND complete absence of monoclonal protein in serum/urine, Congo red birefringence limits, and Vrana (2009) & Mollee (2016, 121/131) laser-microdissection LC-MS/MS subtyping.

episodes.label: Two Counts for One Clone — Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria Budd-Chiari Thrombosis (H030), RBC Hemolysis/Transfusion Dilution vs. Granulocyte FLAER/CD157 Flow Cytometry
episodes.notes: Flow-cytometric lineage gating and survival bias in Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (H030): why red-cell CD55/CD59 clone fractions dramatically underestimate granulocyte/monocyte PNH clone size after complement hemolysis and transfusion in Budd-Chiari syndrome, Brodsky's fluorescent aerolysin (FLAER) binding to GPI anchors, CD157 single-tube multi-lineage validation, and Fattizzo et al.'s clone-evolution cohort.

episodes.label: How Scientists Followed Carbon Through a Tumor — Warburg's 1927 Artery-Vein Lactate Balance, DeBerardinis's 13C NMR Glioblastoma TCA & Glutaminolysis & Hensley's Intraoperative Lung Tumor Infusions
episodes.notes: From the classical Warburg Effect to human intraoperative stable-isotope tracing: Warburg, Wind & Negelein (1927) aerobic glycolysis across rat tumor vessels, DeBerardinis et al. (2007) 13C NMR isotopomer resolution of simultaneous glycolysis, TCA flux, fatty acid synthesis, and glutamine anaplerosis in glioblastoma cells, and Hensley et al. (2016) intraoperative [U-13C]glucose infusions in human NSCLC patients.

episodes.label: Villi, Low-Protein Cytolysis, and Silicone Gels — Veterinary GI Endoscopy, Corn-Oil Lacteals & Feline Ileal Lymphoma (V036), CSF Lumbar Flow, 30-Min Lysis & Neuro-FIP Cure (V037) & Vet TDM, SST Gel Traps & Feline KBr Asthma Ban (V038)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary GI endoscopy (V036), CSF analysis (V037), and veterinary TDM (V038): left lateral positioning, Fleet enema ban, corn-oil lacteals, and feline ileal-only T-cell lymphoma (18-39%); pre-tap MRI, lumbar vs. cisternal CSF, 30-60m oncotic lysis rescue (10% serum/Hetastarch), SRMA IgA, GS-441524 neuro-FIP cure, and equine EPM SAG ratios; and plain red-top vs. SST phenobarbital trap, feline KBr/diazepam bans, KBr chloride kinetics, cyclosporine IL-2 mRNA PD, and feline methimazole CKD unmasking.

episodes.label: Tears, Stria Melanocytes, and Spinal Arcs — Veterinary Ophthalmic Exam, Descemetocele 'Donut Hole' & TonoVet Physics (V033), BAER Deafness Screening, MITF/PMEL Stria Collapse & Cavalier PSOM (V034) & Neurologic Localization, Schiff-Sherrington & the Deep Pain Law (V035)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary ophthalmology/tonometry (V033), BAER deafness screening (V034), and neurologic localization (V035): STT-I sequence, cherry-eye gland preservation, descemetocele fluorescein 'donut hole', collar/species TonoVet traps, and fellow-eye glaucoma prophylaxis; Strain's >12,000 Dalmatian registry, MITF/KIT stria melanocytes, OFA >=35d rule, and Cavalier PSOM bone BAER; and 4 spinal segments, Schiff-Sherrington, paradoxical vestibular tilt, and Olby's Deep Pain & Progressive Myelomalacia laws.

episodes.label: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
episodes.notes: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.

episodes.label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.

episodes.label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
episodes.notes: Dissecting in-vitro potassium artifacts before the analyzer: Mansoor et al. (2015) reverse pseudohyperkalemia (9.5 mmol/L across three analyzers vs. 3.7 mmol/L on hand-carried whole blood due to pneumatic-tube mechanical lysis of fragile leukemic white cells in heparinized plasma), Xiong et al. (2022) familial cold-induced ABCB6 red-cell potassium leak, and Raffee et al. (2022) why a normal ECG cannot rule out true hyperkalemia.

episodes.label: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
episodes.notes: One Medicine epithelial, mucosal, and surgical pathology deep dive (H028, V019, V032): ASCCP unsatisfactory vs. absent-TZ rules, 2025 SELF-CERV vaginal HPV trial (n=599), HPV FOCAL (n=19,009), European pooled RCTs (n=176,464), English HPV vaccine registry (13.7M person-years), gastric-type adenocarcinoma missed by cone biopsy, Kemp (2015) 70-dog liver biopsy concordance (60%-69%), Marsilio (2019) 12/20 healthy cats called small-cell lymphoma on IHC/PARR, 2026 32-dog STS biopsy undergrading, 94-dog STS 3-year margin recurrence (41.2%/22.5%/7.1%), Barillas (2019) demodicosis hair-pluck vs. deep-scrape monitoring, Díaz (2023) post-cure Malassezia qPCR persistence, and Bizikova (2019) 35-cat pemphigus foliaceus relapses (24/31).

episodes.label: Proviral Hiding Places & Shedding Windows — Feline Leukemia p27 Antigen, FIV Maternal Antibodies & Canine Parvovirus SNAP Traps
episodes.notes: Clinical problem cluster in veterinary virology & Bayesian screening (V027, V028, V001): Feline Leukemia Virus (FeLV) soluble p27 capsid antigen ELISA vs. IFA & quantitative proviral DNA/RNA PCR across abortive, regressive (occult bone-marrow integration transmitted via blood transfusion!), and progressive stages; FIV gp40/p24 antibody testing vs. colostral maternal antibodies in kittens <6 months & vaccine interference; low-prevalence positive predictive value (PPV) math requiring orthogonal confirmation; paired with Canine Parvovirus (CPV-2a/2b/2c) fecal antigen ELISA false negatives (dilution, mucosal antibody sequestration, narrow shedding window) vs. PCR post-MLV vaccine false positives.

sections.heading: Chemotherapy Pharmacology, Supportive Care, Outcomes & Lifesaving Drug Access

episodes.label: The Evolution of Cancer Diagnosis and Survival
Why Cancer Isn't Just a Physical Lump
How Zip Codes Predict Cancer Survival
Why Lifesaving Cancer Drugs and Isotopes Vanish
How a Cheap Cancer Cure Vanished
The Letter the First Test Missed — Compound Heterozygous DPYD Variants Missed by 4-SNP Panels (de Haar-Holleman 2024), Fluorouracil Catabolism Collapse & Uridine Triacetate Antidote Rescue
episodes.notes: Pharmacogenomics and biochemical rescue of fluoropyrimidine toxicity: why targeted 4-variant DPYD genotyping misses rare in-trans compound heterozygotes (de Haar-Holleman et al. 2024), phenotypic DPD uracil breath/plasma assays (Coenen et al. 2019), 5-FU catabolic shunting into FUTP/FdUMP (Peters et al. 1988), and emergency antidote rescue with uridine triacetate (Jacob et al. 2022).

episodes.label: The Drug That Quieted the First Wave — Ondansetron & Cisplatin Emesis, 5-HT3A Cryo-EM (PDB 6W1M), Acute 5-HT3 vs. Delayed Substance P/NK1 Phase, hERG QTc Risk & CYP2D6 CPIC
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology of ondansetron and biphasic chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting: Cubeddu & Marty's 1990 cisplatin trials, 2.8 Å cryo-EM structure of 5-HT3A bound to ondansetron (PDB 6W1M), why acute (0–24h) peripheral 5-HT3 vagal signaling gives way to delayed (24–120h) central NK1/Substance P signaling, hERG K+ channel blockade and FDA IV dose caps, and CPIC CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizer guidance.

episodes.label: The Breath Before the Heat — Rising End-Tidal CO2 Before Hyperthermia, Skeletal Muscle RyR1 Calcium Leak, Dantrolene Channel Stabilization & Post-Crisis IVCT/CHCT vs. RYR1 Genetic Testing
episodes.notes: Intraoperative malignant hyperthermia from capnography to channel biophysics: why rising end-tidal carbon dioxide precedes core temperature elevation, uncontrolled skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor (RyR1) sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release, dantrolene sodium stabilization of RyR1, and post-crisis workup integrating RYR1 variant sequencing with caffeine-halothane contracture testing.

episodes.label: The Sugar That Stayed in the Scan — [18F]FDG from 1976–1979 Brain Autoradiography (Sokoloff & Reivich) and Cyclotron 109.77-Min Decay to GLUT3/Hexokinase II Trapping (4ZW9/2NZT), Thoracic SUVmax 7.2 & EBUS Granulomas
episodes.notes: From cyclotron target to thoracic staging needle: Sokoloff's 1977 [14C]deoxyglucose method and Reivich/Alavi/Phelps's 1976-1979 human [18F]FDG brain studies, Hamacher nucleophilic synthesis and 109.77-minute half-life batch logistics (21 CFR 212.70), D-glucose-bound GLUT3 (PDB 4ZW9) and human hexokinase II (PDB 2NZT) metabolic trapping, 511-keV coincidence physics and SUVbw math (7.2 g/mL), and why bilateral FDG-avid mediastinal nodes still require EBUS-TBNA tissue confirmation (granulomatous inflammation vs. metastasis).

episodes.label: The Drug That Cut the Drug — Glucarpidase Methotrexate Rescue, DAMPA Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. HPLC/LC-MS/MS (5.79 vs. 2.27 µmol/L at Hour 117, Gulley 2020), Ogawa Tissue Rebound & Organ Recovery
episodes.notes: Enzymatic drug cleavage and analytical cross-reactivity after high-dose methotrexate rescue with glucarpidase (carboxypeptidase G2): Gulley et al.'s (2020) split specimen 74 hours post-glucarpidase reading 5.79 µmol/L by immunoassay vs. 2.27 µmol/L by HPLC due to DAMPA metabolite persistence beyond the nominal 48-hour VORAXAZE label window, Ogawa et al.'s (2024) 98.83% 20-minute plasma drop and tissue rebound, and Corbisier et al.'s (2024) multimodal pediatric liver/renal recovery.

episodes.label: Shadows, Acoustic Windows & Operator Hands — Two-View Veterinary Radiography, Ultrasound Artifacts, Twisted Stomachs & Missing Stones
episodes.notes: One Medicine diagnostic imaging deep dive (V013, V014, H005, H032): 5 radiographic opacities & 3-view thoracic gravity physics, ICRP/ACVR collimation vs. digital cropping eye-lens scatter, AI dataset shift traps, pulmonary metastasis CT vs. X-ray size thresholds, counterclockwise canine GDV missed as sand impaction, Vizsla shotgun survival vs. Cane Corso forensic necropsy, Hermann's tortoise retained egg, paired with B-mode ultrasound physics, AFAST fluid scores vs. centesis, feline moth-eaten spleen & canine cavitated splenic hemangiosarcoma myths (42% Se / 51% Sp), feline ureteroliths, liver biopsy PCV drops, and equine colic FLASH.

episodes.label: The Colon Cancer Signal in the Diet Survey — Fecal Immunochemical Screening Conversion, MGMT Cys145 Suicide Alkyl Transfer, Le Leu's Red-Meat vs. Butyrylated-Starch Rectal Crypt Biopsies & UK Biobank GxE
episodes.notes: Separating stool hemoglobin screening, mucosal adduct biology, and observational nutritional epidemiology: FIT buffer-to-feces (µg Hb/g) conversion, human MGMT Cys145 suicidal O6-methylguanine repair (PDB 1EH6/1T38), Le Leu et al. (2015) randomized high-red-meat ± butyrylated resistant starch rectal biopsy O6MeG adduct trial, and gene-by-diet interaction studies.

episodes.label: What a Bright Spot on a PET Scan Is Made Of — Sokoloff's 1977 [14C]Deoxyglucose Hexokinase Trap, Reivich & Phelps's 1979 Human [18F]FDG-PET & Kubota's 1992 Macrophage Microautoradiography
episodes.notes: Biochemical basis and diagnostic specificity of [18F]FDG-PET (H022): Sokoloff et al.'s (1977) hexokinase metabolic trapping of 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, Reivich & Phelps's (1979) human positron emission tomography translation, Som et al.'s (1980) oncologic uptake, and Kubota et al.'s (1992) cellular microautoradiography proving why activated macrophages and granulation tissue generate intense FDG avidity indistinguishable from cancer on a single SUV number.

episodes.label: How a Cell Builds Insulin from One Chain — Sanger's Two-Chain Disulfide Puzzle, Steiner & Oyer's 1967 Human Islet Tumor Pulse-Chase Proinsulin Precursor & Equimolar C-Peptide Secretion
episodes.notes: Discovery of prohormone processing: why isolated insulin A and B chains recombine inefficiently in vitro, Steiner & Oyer (1967) identification of single-chain proinsulin in human islet-cell adenoma slices, pulse-chase proof of intracellular proteolytic conversion into two-chain insulin, and Rubenstein, Clark & Steiner (1969) equimolar C-peptide co-secretion enabling clinical distinction between endogenous and exogenous insulin.

episodes.label: The Seed the Scan Could Not Name — Adult Occult Sapodilla Seed Aspiration (Nguyen Phan 2026), Two-Year Unilateral Wheeze & Flexible Bronchoscopy Extraction (H049)
episodes.notes: Pulmonary diagnostics and flexible bronchoscopy (H049) for occult adult airway foreign bodies: Nguyen Phan et al.'s (2026) two-year missed sapodilla seed aspiration masquerading as recurrent right-lower-lobe pneumonia and asthma, radiolucent organic foreign-body CT physics, granulation-tissue tumor mimics, and flexible vs. rigid bronchoscopic retrieval across adult cohorts (Jang et al. 2022; Purohit et al. 2023).

episodes.label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of tissue histopathology (H029), multiparameter flow cytometry (H030), and veterinary helical CT (V016): cold ischemia, formalin kinetics, Elmore's 240x115 breast biopsy concordance and STR floater checks; MBL, TRBC1, COG/EuroFlow MRD, and anti-CD19 lineage switch; and canine lung staging (41/459 nodules on X-ray), breath-hold recruitment, 66-dog portosystemic shunt CTA, and caval tumor-thrombus mapping.

episodes.label: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
episodes.notes: One Medicine gastrointestinal endoscopy and mucosal biopsy investigation (H047 & V036): why optically normal human esophageal mucosa can conceal severe eosinophilic esophagitis (169 eosinophils/HPF) unless multilevel biopsies are taken, why canine gastric masses mimicking neoplasia on endoscopy require submucosal histology and special stains, and patchy sampling error.
